GiftMode.script_style_notes: Conversational, relatable, first-person storytelling. Use 'I' and 'you'. Short punchy sentences. Emotional payoff before CTA.
hook_patterns: She said it was fine. It was not fine.

Tinlance.script_style_notes: Authoritative but direct. Lead with a consequence the audience fears. Use specific numbers and real scenarios. No fluff. End with a clear next step.
hook_patterns: Your [asset] was compromised. You found out [delayed timeframe] later.
Most [audience] think they're too small to be [threat]. They're wrong.
I watched a client lose $[amount] in one [timeframe] breach.
This is what a [attack type] looks like from the inside.
[Number] businesses in [region] got hit last [period]. Were you one of them?

WebTemify.script_style_notes: Fast, technical but accessible. Show before you tell. Emphasis on speed, results, and no-fluff efficiency. Founders and developers respect brevity and specificity.
hook_patterns: I built a [result] in [short timeframe]. Here's exactly how.
Stop building from scratch. This template does [X] for you.
Your landing page is losing you [money/users]. Fix it in [time].
This is what [X] lines of code looks like in [timeframe].

HezCast.script_style_notes: Founder-to-founder energy. Show the product working. Lead with the result. Use specific numbers. Fast, confident, direct.
hook_patterns: I generated 30 videos for 3 brands in one afternoon. Here's how.
This is what AI content infrastructure looks like in 2026.
Stop making videos manually. This changes everything.
POV: Your content engine just became autonomous.
We built the tool that builds our marketing. Let me show you.
